Zaiqa Billing, Zaiqa Waiter and Zaiqa Kitchen apps, version 2.15.3.

Backup now downloads to the phone
- "Download backup" saves the backup .json file in the phone's Downloads folder (you see a message with the file name).
- "Share backup" is still there for sending it to Drive, WhatsApp or email.
- Restore any time with "Restore a backup file" and pick the .json file.
- CSV reports also save to Downloads.
